title: factory: record toolchain proof
body: Checks the task toolchain, the root volume, and the task user's isolation on an EC2 worker. Safe to close without merging.

change.run: mkdir -p proofs && node -e 'const os = require("os"); console.log(JSON.stringify({ run: process.env.FACTORY_RUN_ID, user: os.userInfo().username, node: process.version }))' > "proofs/$FACTORY_RUN_ID.json"
